content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to publish web content directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can set up an online store for your ebooks, courses, templates, and more without incurring monthly fees or facing payment processing restrictions. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge 10% on every sale, utilizing GitHub Pages and NOWPayments can significantly reduce your costs, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several key components working in conjunction: GitHub Pages for hosting your static site, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for handling backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This setup ensures that you can deliver your products instantly while maintaining full data ownership. The system automatically verifies payments without any buyers needing to create accounts, streamlining the user experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is tailored for digital creators in areas where conventional payment platforms are not viable. If you are selling digital goods like music beats, presets, or software, this stack provides a reliable means to conduct sales without the constraints imposed by popular payment processors. By leveraging this architecture, you can focus on creating and selling, knowing that your infrastructure is secure and efficient.
GitHub Pages offers free, reliable hosting without platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The main components include: 1) GitHub Pages for static site hosting, 2) NOWPayments for automated cryptocurrency payment processing, 3) Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and 4) a storage solution like Google Drive for file delivery. Each component is essential; GitHub Pages hosts your storefront, while NOWPayments ensures that you receive payments swiftly and securely, all without depending on a third-party platform.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, set up your GitHub account and create a new repository for your project. Upload your digital products and configure your GitHub Pages settings to publish your site. Next, use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to write the backend logic for product delivery and payment verification. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle your crypto transactions. This straightforward process will empower you to launch your digital store quickly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to just 0.5%, saving you money.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up GitHub Pages?

To set up GitHub Pages, create a new repository on GitHub and upload your files. Then, navigate to the repository settings, find the GitHub Pages section, and choose the main branch to publish your site. Your digital storefront is now live.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This flexibility allows you to cater to a global audience without the constraints of traditional currency.
How do I handle digital product delivery?

Digital product delivery is automated through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which can send users a download link upon payment confirmation. This ensures that customers receive their purchases immediately without manual intervention.
Can I customize my store's appearance?
Yes, you can fully customize your store's appearance by editing the HTML and CSS of your GitHub Pages site. This allows you to create a unique brand identity that resonates with your audience.
Is there any ongoing cost after I set this up?
No, once you set up your store on GitHub Pages with NOWPayments, there are no ongoing costs or subscription fees. You retain full ownership of your infrastructure and profits.
You maintain complete control over your digital product sales process.
